findings.summary: About 40 screens of near-identical cards with nothing to help choose one. On a phone this could make a reader give up.
The company name appears only at the top of each group, so after scrolling the reader can't tell whose track a card belongs to.
Fees are shown only as percentages. The reader wants the yearly amount in ₪ for their own balance, which is a wish for more.
The S&P card shows 99% stocks and 99% foreign currency, which confused the reader. Both figures can be right at once, so this is a brief puzzle rather than a blocker.
Many cards show 'less than 3 years' with no return figure. This reflects young tracks, not a page fault, so it doesn't block use.
The cheapest fee is mentioned in the summary line, but there's no way to jump to that track. This is about navigation, not the alphabetical sort order.
There's no button or next step to actually open the fund, which is a wish for more.
